title: German Far-Right Surges, in Threat to Postwar Taboo on Extremists in Power
summary_full: Sunday’s vote in the state of Saxony-Anhalt could produce the strongest showing in the history of the Alternative for Germany party, and potentially a far-right government in the statehouse.
